newsitem.title: USA: Soros group has stake in Hain Food Group.
newsitem.headline: Soros group has stake in Hain Food Group.

text.p: A group led by international financier George Soros said it has acquired 746,700 shares of Hain Food Group Inc., or 8.71 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission the Soros group said it bought the stake for investment purposes.

The group said it bought 545,200 of the shares between Dec. 20 and Feb. 13 at prices ranging from $3.695 to $5.605 a share. It also said it bought call options for 550 contracts, each exercisable for 100 shares, at prices ranging from $62.81 to $90.00 each.
